## Objective
- Build a polished 3D 1v1 Rocket League–style car-soccer game in Three.js, played against a bot, first to 3 goals.

## Requirements
- 3D, 1v1, Rocket League-like gameplay vs a bot.
- Match ends when either side reaches 3 goals.
- User asked for AAA/visually beautiful quality in an earlier runtime prompt (FPS request context), implying high visual polish and iterative visual verification.
- Must support desktop and mobile/touch, responsive layouts, safe areas, and usable controls.
- Use Three.js, local assets, no runtime network dependencies.
- Verify visually via Playwright/SwiftShader; screenshots must show real gameplay, not blank/loading screens.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/JS site with ES modules + import map; Three.js 0.187.0 vendored under `vendor/three`.
- No `package.json` at project root (default start script treats non-Vite package projects as unsupported). Plain `index.html` static deployment.
- Arena dimensions: 64 × 92, walls 15.5, goals 20 × 9 × 9 deep; player attacks −z, bot attacks +z.
- Fixed-step physics at 120 Hz; postprocessing via EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass + OutputPass.
- Audio fully procedural via WebAudio (engine, hits, goals, crowd).
- Bot AI difficulty presets: Rookie / Pro (default) / All-Star.
- Mobile: touch joystick + boost/jump buttons, portrait camera pulled back with wider FOV.
- Verdict: functional game logic works; visual tuning is in progress.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full playable game scaffold: menu, start screen, difficulty selection, HUD, scoreboard, boost gauge, speed readout, goal banner, pause overlay, result/victory screen, rematch and menu buttons.
- Arena with floor markings, glass walls, stands/crowd, goals with nets/halos, ceiling lights, boost pads, banners.
- Car model with paint, cabin, spoiler, wheels, flames, underglow removed later; physics: throttle, reverse, steering, grip, boost, jump/double-jump, air control, wall/arena limits, visual roll/pitch/flip.
- Ball texture, halo, lighting, trail, wall/floor/net bounce, car collision impulses.
- Bot AI with positioning behind ball toward player goal, defense bias, boost, jump/aerial attempts, reaction/aim error, stuck recovery.
- Procedural audio and input manager (keyboard, touch, gamepad).
- Goal detection, kickoff countdown, first-to-3 match end, stats screen, confetti.
- Playwright functional test passed core logic: start → play, bot moves, ball hit registers, goals increment, result populates, rematch resets.
- Fixed low-FPS simulation lag by raising `dt` cap/max steps; added software-renderer detection and reduced quality settings.
- Removed car underglow disc and boost-pad glow sprites/beams (visual cleanup).
- Added favicon, bundled Chakra Petch/Rajdhani fonts, README untouched.

### Active
- Visual iteration on screenshot quality (contrast, glare, bloom intensity, menu readability, camera framing).
- Diagnosing a large orange/cyan floor wash near boost pads; latest diagnostic was invalid because a bot goal switched the camera during captures.
- Performance in SwiftShader is poor (~5.5–7 FPS); no-post/no-shadow/low-pixel-ratio only modestly improves it.
- Need final desktop/mobile screenshots and gameplay action shots.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Re-run diagnostic with game paused immediately after `#play-btn` click (and verify camera stays behind player) to isolate the orange floor wash; likely bloom halo from bright additive boost-pad rings or environment reflection.
2. Consider raising bloom threshold to ~1.0–1.05 to stop LDR pad rings from blooming; keep emissive HUD/arena lights glowing.
3. Improve menu readability with a dark scrim behind `.menu-inner` / stronger title shadow.
4. Adjust goal-celebration camera distance/height; current goal view is too close, filling screen with net.
5. Fix low-FPS catch-up (allow ~20–24 physics steps or larger dt) so screenshots after 1s show meaningful movement.
6. Run full match E2E with proper waits (goal timer 2.9s, kickoff 2.1s) and verify `VICTORY`/`DEFEAT`, stats and rematch.
7. Capture final desktop (1440×900) and touch-emulated mobile screenshots; visually inspect and iterate.
8. Ensure no console/page errors; favicon 404 fixed via `assets/favicon.svg`.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: DOM/HUD/menu/pause/result markup, import map, favicon.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: all UI, responsive/mobile/touch, menu, HUD, goal banner, result styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: bootstrap, renderer/postprocessing, game state, camera, scoring, HUD updates, debug API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/arena.js`: arena geometry, lights, goals, crowd, boost pads, banners.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/car.js`: car model + arcade physics + visual effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ball.js`: ball physics, collisions, scoring/net constraint, trail.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/bot.js`: NOVA AI and difficulty presets.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: procedural floor/ball/net/banner/glow textures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/particles.js`: pooled additive particle field (trails, sparks, confetti).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio engine/sfx.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js`: keyboard/touch/gamepad controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/utils.js`: math/clock helpers.
- `/tmp/opencode/test-game.mjs`: functional Playwright test (start, drive, collision, goals, rematch).
- `/tmp/opencode/diag2.mjs`: paused-scene diagnostic script (latest run produced invalid crop due to goal camera switch).
- `/tmp/opencode/perf2.mjs`: FPS/quality variant measurements.
- `/tmp/opencode/screens/`: captured screenshots (`menu3`, `play3`, `diag2-*`, crops).

## Important Context
- Dev server running in tmux session `game` on port 3002: `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime ./start.sh`; log `/tmp/opencode/game.log`.
- Capture command used: `CAPTURE_URL=http://localhost:3002/ CAPTURE_DIR=<dir> CAPTURE_START_SELECTOR='#play-btn' ./capture.sh`; menu capture uses `CAPTURE_AUTO_START=false CAPTURE_READY_SELECTOR='#play-btn'`.
- Runtime Playwright launcher: `~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright`, display file `~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/display`, config `linux.json`; requires `DISPLAY` env.
- Software renderer detection works: `window.__game.softwareRenderer === true` in SwiftShader.
- Debug API `window.__game` exposes `mode`, `score`, `time`, `difficulty`, `fps`, `player`, `bot`, `ball`, `arena`, `renderer`, `composer`, `bloom`, `scene`, `camera`, `setQuality({post,bloom,shadows,pixelRatio})`, `start`, `menu`, `forceGoal`, `finishGoal`, `skipKickoff`, `setPlayer`, `setBall`, `setDifficulty`, `camera`.
- Scoring guard: `window.__game.forceGoal()` only works if mode is not `goal`/`over`; goal timer 2.9s, kickoff 2.1s.
- Arena object names for diagnostics: `arena-floor`, `boost-pad`, `goal-light`, `goal-halo`, `ceiling-light`, `light-bank`, `key-light`, `fill-light`, `warm-light`.
- Current visuals: menu title sometimes hard to read over bright arena; ball pattern visible but pale; no underglow; pad rings remain additive and may bloom.
- No git commit has been made for any game work; files are untracked/modified in the working tree.
- SwiftShader FPS ~5.5–7; lowering pixel ratio and disabling bloom/shadows gave only ~7–8 FPS, so performance under software rendering remains a known limitation.

## Objective
- Build a polished 3D 1v1 Rocket League–style car-soccer game in Three.js, played against a bot, first to 3 goals.

## Requirements
- 3D, 1v1, Rocket League-like gameplay vs a bot; match ends when either side reaches 3 goals.
- High visual polish and iterative screenshot verification; screenshots must show real gameplay, not blank/loading screens.
- Desktop and mobile/touch support with responsive layouts, safe areas, and usable controls.
- Use Three.js and local assets with no runtime network dependencies.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/JS site with ES modules + import map; Three.js 0.187.0 vendored under `vendor/three`.
- No `package.json` at project root; plain `index.html` static deployment.
- Arena: 64 × 92, walls 15.5, goals 20 × 9 × 9 deep; player attacks −z, bot attacks +z.
- Fixed-step physics at 120 Hz; `EffectComposer` + `UnrealBloomPass` + `OutputPass`.
- Audio fully procedural via WebAudio (engine, hits, goals, crowd).
- Bot difficulty presets: Rookie / Pro (default) / All-Star.
- Mobile: touch joystick + boost/jump, portrait camera pulled back with wider FOV; touch controls only during match via `body.touch.in-match`; added top-right pause button.
- Verdict: game is functional and visually polished; final verification captures remain.

## Work State
### Completed
- Full playable game: menu, difficulty selection, HUD, scoreboard, boost gauge, speed readout, goal banner, pause overlay, result screen, rematch/menu.
- Arena with floor markings, glass walls, stands/crowd, goals with nets/halos, ceiling lights, boost pads, banners.
- Car model/physics, ball physics/collisions, bot AI, procedural audio, input manager, goal detection, kickoff countdown, first-to-3 match end, stats, confetti.
- Removed car underglow and boost-pad glow sprites/beams; fixed favicon; bundled fonts.
- Fixed orange/cyan floor wash: reduced floor `envMapIntensity` to 0.28, metalness 0.14, roughness 0.62.
- Fixed car roof bloom hotspot: reduced paint clearcoat/env intensity and roof/hood stripe emissive to 0.8.
- Improved ball readability: darker base texture, stronger orange panels/seams, lower clearcoat/env intensity.
- Added menu radial scrim behind `.menu-inner`; hid arena banners in menu and during goal celebration; restored on kickoff.
- Pulled goal camera back to y 11.4 / 23 units; result camera orbit reduced to radius 29, y 11.5.
- Improved low-FPS catch-up: dt cap 0.14, up to 18 physics steps (play), 16 (kickoff/goal), 8 (menu/over).
- Particle shader near-fade + max 64px; boost trail refined to compact sparks.
- Added mobile pause button (`#pause-btn`) with `pointer-events: auto`; hides outside match.
- Responsive scoreboard/pause-button fixes down to 320px width; rotate hint moved above touch controls.
- Fixed `PCFSoftShadowMap` deprecation warning; removed unused `THREE.Clock`.
- Resize respects software-renderer pixel-ratio cap.
- Playwright functional E2E passed: start, drive (174 km/h), hit, goals, VICTORY, DEFEAT, stats populate, rematch resets, menu returns; no page/console errors.
- Touch test passed: joystick drives, jump lifts car, boost sets `boosting`, pause/resume works.

### Active
- Final visual verification and screenshot selection.
- Last E2E run succeeded on retry; an earlier run timed out on a result-button click under heavy software-rendering load.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect final `goal-celebration.png` (new camera/banner state) and latest result screenshots; adjust only if needed.
2. Re-run final E2E once more serially (no concurrent browser) to confirm stability under SwiftShader.
3. Capture final desktop menu/play/action and touch-emulated mobile menu/play screenshots.
4. Confirm no console/page errors or failed requests in final runs.
5. Stop the dev server or leave as needed; no commit has been made.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: bootstrap, renderer/postprocessing, game state, camera, scoring, HUD, debug API.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/arena.js`: arena geometry, lights, goals, crowd, boost pads, banner visibility.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/car.js`: car model/physics, paint/stripe materials, boost trail.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ball.js`: ball physics, collisions, halo, trail.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/bot.js`: NOVA AI and difficulty presets.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: procedural floor/ball/net/banner/glow textures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/particles.js`: pooled additive particle field with near-fade shader.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js`: keyboard/touch/gamepad controls.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: HUD, pause button, menu, pause/result markup, import map, favicon.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: all UI, menu scrim, responsive/mobile/touch, pause button.
- `/tmp/opencode/e2e.mjs`: full-match Playwright test with screenshots.
- `/tmp/opencode/mobile2.mjs`: touch mobile menu/play/pause capture and pause verification.
- `/tmp/opencode/hero.mjs`: hero/action screenshot setup.
- `/tmp/opencode/screens/`: captured screenshots (`play4`, `menu5`, `final-mobile-*`, `hero-1`, `goal-celebration`, `result-*`).
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio engine/sfx.

## Important Context
- Dev server runs in tmux session `game` on port 3002; command: `PORT=3002 RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime ./start.sh`; log `/tmp/opencode/game.log`.
- Runtime Playwright: `~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright`; requires `export DISPLAY=:$(cat ~/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/display)`.
- Debug API `window.__game` exposes `mode`, `score`, `time`, `difficulty`, `fps`, `player`, `bot`, `ball`, `arena`, `renderer`, `composer`, `bloom`, `scene`, `camera` (cameraState), `threeCamera`, `setQuality`, `start`, `menu`, `forceGoal`, `finishGoal`, `skipKickoff`, `setPlayer`, `setBall`, `setDifficulty`.
- `window.__game.mode` is a getter; assigning it silently fails. Pause via Escape/`#pause-btn`, then hide `#pause` overlay for diagnostic screenshots.
- Goal timer 2.9s; kickoff 2.1s; goal banner hides at 2.3s. Result appears after goal timer when score reaches 3.
- SwiftShader FPS ~6 desktop / ~16 mobile; lowering quality gives limited improvement. Concurrent Playwright browsers severely reduce FPS and can cause flaky timeouts.
- No git commit has been made; all game files are untracked in the working tree.
